map.物业服务品质检查体系，涵盖保洁/安保/绿化/设施四大服务模块的品质检查与整改评估: Property service quality inspection system covering quality checks and rectification assessment across the cleaning, security, greening and facilities modules
map.📖 查看「品质（检查/标准/整改）体系 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Quality (Inspection / Standard / Rectification) System" guide
map.加权品质分：各检查项按 优 4 分、良 3 分、中 2 分、差 1 分 计分；模: Weighted quality score: each check item scores excellent 4, good 3, fair 2, poor 1; module score rate = Σ(item score × item weight) ÷ Σ(item weight × 4) × 100%; total score weights each module score rate by module weight; items scoring 2 or below go on the rectification list.
map.对每项指标评分（优=4/良=3/中=2/差=1），系统自动计算综合品质得分与整改: Score each metric (excellent=4/good=3/fair=2/poor=1); the system automatically computes the composite quality score and rectification advice
map.四大模块加权：保洁25% + 安保25% + 绿化20% + 设施30%: Four modules weighted: cleaning 25% + security 25% + greening 20% + facilities 30%
map.综合得分≥85分为优秀，70-84分为良好，55-69分为合格，<55分为不合格: A composite score of 85 or above is excellent, 70-84 good, 55-69 pass, below 55 fail
map.📚 深度解析：品质（检查/标准/整改）体系: 📚 Deep dive: quality (inspection / standard / rectification) system
map.物业用检查表对公共区域逐项打分: Property management scores common areas item by item with a checklist
map.问题项按权重排序优先整改: Problem items are prioritised for rectification by weight
map.迎检（街道、行业）前自查达标: Self-check compliance before a street or industry inspection
map.地面无污渍（3 分）、玻璃无水渍（2）、楼道无杂物（2）、消防通道畅通（3）、草: Floor free of stains (3 points), glass free of water marks (2), corridors free of clutter (2), fire escape route clear (3), lawn free of yellowing (2), trees free of dead branches (2) → maximum 14; 3 points deducted in practice (glass + corridors) → 11 points.
map.消防通道占用（3 分）优先于草坪枯黄（2 分），先清占再补绿，权重高项对总评分影: Fire escape route occupied (3 points) takes priority over yellowing lawn (2 points): clear the obstruction first, then re-green; higher-weighted items affect the total score more.
map.检查表权重怎么设？: How should checklist weights be set?
map.安全类（消防、通道）权重最高，外观类次之，体现风险优先。: Safety items (fire protection, escape routes) carry the highest weight, appearance items next, reflecting risk-first priority.
map.得分低一定不合格吗？: Does a low score always mean a failure?
map.看阈值，通常 85% 以上合格；安全项一票否决，占用消防通道直接判不合格。: Look at the threshold; usually 85% or above passes. Safety items are a single-vote veto, so occupying a fire escape route fails the check outright.
